f.title: Establish and maintain the PV system according to GVP Module I
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance systems of the MAH and of the Agency must be established and maintained in accordance with GVP Module I.

f.title: Treat medication errors, off-label use, misuse and abuse as ADRs; report on suspicion
f.statement: Adverse reactions include harmful and unintended effects resulting from medication errors and use outside the terms of the marketing authorisation, including misuse and abuse. A suspected causal relationship is sufficient reason for reporting.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: (1) Nuspojavom se smatraju i štetni i neželjeni učinci koji su posljedica i medikacijskih pogrešaka te primjene lijeka izvan uvjeta odobrenja za stavljanje lijeka u promet uključujući pogrešnu uporabu i zlouporabu lijeka. (2) Sumnja na moguću uzročno-posljedičnu povezanost između primjene lijeka i nuspojave dovoljan je razlog za prijavljivanje.

rows.quote_en: (1) Harmful and unintended effects that result from medication errors and from use of the medicinal product outside the terms of the marketing authorisation, including misuse and abuse of the medicinal product, are also considered adverse reactions. (2) A suspicion of a possible causal relationship between use of the medicinal product and the adverse reaction is sufficient reason for reporting.

f.title: Report lack of therapeutic efficacy per GVP Module VI
f.statement: Applicants, MAHs, parallel import authorisation holders, importers and wholesalers (and healthcare professionals) must report therapeutic failure of a medicinal product in accordance with GVP Module VI.

f.title: Define causality assessment algorithms in the PV system
f.statement: The Agency and MAHs should have defined algorithms within their pharmacovigilance systems for assessing the causal relationship between an adverse event and the medicinal product, in accordance with GVP Module VI.

rows.quote: Agencija i nositelji odobrenja u okviru svojih farmakovigilancijskih sustava trebaju imati definirane algoritme za ocjenu uzročno-posljedične povezanosti između štetnog događaja i primijenjenog lijeka

f.title: Classify seriousness using the legal criteria and the HALMED list of serious ADRs
f.statement: An adverse reaction is serious if it led to death, a life-threatening condition, hospitalisation or prolongation of hospitalisation, permanent or severe disability or incapacity, a congenital anomaly or birth defect, or another medically important condition; other medically important conditions include reactions on the List of serious adverse reactions published by the Agency. All others are non-serious.

f.title: Record ADRs reported by HCPs to MAH representatives on the MAH local ADR form
f.statement: Healthcare professionals visited by an MAH representative must also report observed ADRs to that representative; the data are entered on the MAH's local adverse reaction form.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Local PV interfaces

f.title: Treat an ADR report as valid with identifiable reporter, patient, suspect product and reaction
f.statement: A valid ADR report must contain at least an identifiable reporter, an identifiable patient/user (initials and/or age and/or sex), the suspect product name (trade name and/or INN) and the adverse reaction.

rows.quote: Valjana prijava nuspojave treba sadržavati najmanje sljedeće podatke o: – prijavitelju kojeg je moguće identificirati, – pacijentu/korisniku lijeka kojeg je moguće identificirati (inicijali i/ili dob i/ili spol), – nazivu lijeka koji je pod sumnjom (tvorničko ime i/ili INN), – nuspojavi.
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. rows.quote_en: A valid adverse reaction report should contain at least the following data on: – an identifiable reporter, – an identifiable patient/user of the medicinal product (initials and/or age and/or sex), – the name of the suspected medicinal product (trade name and/or INN), – the adverse reaction.

f.title: Protect reporter identity: send reporter data in the ICSR only to the Agency
f.statement: When an ADR is reported via the MAH, the MAH must protect the reporter's identity by providing reporter data in the ICSR exclusively to the Agency and must not disclose it to third parties.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: Prilikom prijave nuspojave preko nositelja odobrenja, nositelj odobrenja obvezan je štititi identitet prijavitelja na način da podatke o prijavitelju u prijavi Sigurnosnog izvješća o pojedinačnom slučaju (u daljnjem tekstu: ICSR-a) dostavlja isključivo Agenciji, i ne smije ga otkrivati trećim osobama.

f.title: Electronic vaccine ICSRs to the Agency also satisfy reporting to the public health institute
f.statement: Electronic reporting of vaccine ICSRs to the Agency by manufacturers, MAHs, parallel import holders, importers and wholesalers fulfils the reporting obligation; those ICSRs need not also be reported to the Croatian Institute of Public Health (HZJZ).

rows.actor: MAH, manufacturer, parallel import holder, importer or wholesaler (Croatia)
rows.quote: Elektroničko prijavljivanje ICSR-a cjepiva od strane proizvođača lijeka, nositelja odobrenja, nositelja odobrenja za paralelni uvoz, uvoznika te veleprodaje Agenciji sukladno članku 151. Zakona smatra se izvršavanjem obveze iz članka 145. stavka 1. Zakona, te navedene ICSR-e nije potrebno prijavljivati i HZJZ-u.

rows.quote_en: Electronic reporting of vaccine ICSRs by the manufacturer, marketing authorisation holder, parallel import authorisation holder, importer and wholesaler to the Agency in accordance with Article 151 of the Act is considered fulfilment of the obligation under Article 145(1) of the Act, and these ICSRs need not also be reported to the HZJZ.

f.title: Appoint a Croatia-resident local person responsible for pharmacovigilance
f.statement: The MAH's person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Croatia (local responsible person) must meet the conditions of the Medicinal Products Act and Articles 20-21 and must reside in Croatia.

rows.quote: (1) Odgovorna osoba za farmakovigilanciju nositelja odobrenja za stavljanje lijeka u promet u Republici Hrvatskoj (u daljnjem tekstu: lokalna odgovorna osoba) mora ispunjavati uvjete iz članka 3. točke 58. Zakona i članka 20. i 21. ovoga Pravilnika. (2) Lokalna odgovorna osoba mora imati prebivalište u Republici Hrvatskoj.

rows.quote_en: (1) The person responsible for pharmacovigilance of the marketing authorisation holder in the Republic of Croatia (hereinafter: local responsible person) must fulfil the conditions of Article 3, point 58 of the Act and Articles 20 and 21 of this Ordinance. (2) The local responsible person must have residence in the Republic of Croatia.

f.title: Use a contracted local responsible person only from an entity registered for PV activity
f.statement: If the local responsible person is not an MAH employee, the MAH should appoint a contracted local responsible person who must have a registered activity for adverse reaction monitoring/pharmacovigilance or be employed by a legal entity in Croatia with such registered activity.
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Ako lokalna odgovorna osoba nije zaposlenik nositelja odobrenja, nositelj odobrenja treba imenovati ugovornu lokalnu odgovornu osobu, koja mora imati registriranu djelatnost za praćenje nuspojava, odnosno poslova farmakovigilancije ili biti u radnom odnosu u pravnoj osobi koja u Republici Hrvatskoj ima registriranu djelatnost za praćenje nuspojava, odnosno poslova farmakovigilancije.

rows.quote_en: If the local responsible person is not an employee of the marketing authorisation holder, the marketing authorisation holder should appoint a contracted local responsible person, who must have a registered activity for monitoring of adverse reactions, i.e. pharmacovigilance activities, or be employed by a legal person that has a registered activity for monitoring of adverse reactions, i.e. pharmacovigilance activities, in the Republic of Croatia.

f.title: Give a non-physician local responsible person documented access to a physician
f.statement: If the local responsible person is not a medical doctor, a medical doctor must be available to them and this must be appropriately documented.

rows.quote: Ako lokalna odgovorna osoba nije doktor medicine, mora imati dostupnog doktora medicine, što mora biti odgovarajuće dokumentirano.

rows.quote_en: If the local responsible person is not a medical doctor, they must have a medical doctor available, which must be appropriately documented.

f.title: Appoint one local responsible person per PV system and file the Agency approval in time
f.statement: The MAH appoints one local responsible person for each PV system covering products authorised in Croatia and must submit a copy of the Agency's approval of the local responsible person at the latest when a centrally authorised product is placed on the Croatian market, or submit the approval (or proof of application for it) before applying for a national, MRP or DCP marketing authorisation.

f.title: One local responsible person may cover several PV systems or MAHs if able to meet all duties
f.statement: By exception, one local responsible person may be appointed for several PV systems of one MAH, and may run separate or partly shared PV systems for several MAHs, provided they can fulfil all obligations.

f.title: Make the local responsible person accountable for the Croatian PV system and reachable 24 hours
f.statement: The local responsible person is responsible for establishing and running the MAH's PV system in Croatia, must have an overview of the safety profile and all safety issues of the MAH's products, is the Agency's contact person available 24 hours, and is the contact person for pharmacovigilance inspection in Croatia.
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Audit & inspection readiness

f.title: Document any delegation by the local responsible person while keeping full oversight
f.statement: The local responsible person may delegate part of the work to suitably qualified and trained staff while keeping full overview of the safety profile and all safety issues; every such delegation must be appropriately documented.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder / local person responsible for PV (Croatia)
rows.quote: Lokalna odgovorna osoba može dio poslova prenijeti odgovarajućim kvalificiranim i obučenim radnicima, ali tako da zadrži potpuni pregled nad sigurnosnim profilom i svim sigurnosnim pitanjima nad lijekovima nositelja odobrenja. rows.quote_en: The local responsible person may transfer part of the work to suitably qualified and trained employees, but so as to retain a complete overview of the safety profile and all safety issues of the marketing authorisation holder's medicinal products. Every such transfer of work must be appropriately documented.

f.title: Keep Croatian ADR data accessible at one place in Croatia and route safety documents via the local responsible person
f.statement: The local responsible person must oversee the PV system to ensure at least: a system collecting and collating all suspected ADRs occurring in Croatia so they are fully accessible at one place in Croatia; preparation, obtaining and/or forwarding of ICSRs, PSURs, RMPs with additional risk minimisation measures, DSURs and DHPCs submitted to the Agency; reporting new post-authorisation safety knowledge; complete and prompt answers to Agency requests including sales or prescription volumes; and any other benefit-risk information including post-authorisation studies.
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Data integrity & records; Submission operations

f.statement: The local responsible person's activities should ensure the PV system functions in all other parts, including quality assurance control, SOPs, databases, contractual programmes and compliance with the Act and the Ordinance.

f.title: Ensure the local responsible person has the required qualification, experience and PV training
f.statement: A local responsible person who is not a clinical pharmacology specialist but a medical doctor, dentist, pharmacist, medical biochemist or veterinarian without two years' documented PV experience must have at least two years' professional experience and documented training in PV concepts, spontaneous and solicited reporting, and ADR reporting/assessment and preparation of ICSRs, PSURs, RMPs and DSURs.

f.title: Keep records of the PV responsible person's continuous professional training
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance must continuously undertake professional training in pharmacovigilance and keep records of it.

rows.quote_en: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance must continuously undertake professional development in the field of pharmacovigilance and keep records thereof.

f.title: Apply to the Agency for approval of the local responsible person; extra person only for a new PV system
f.statement: The application for approval of the local responsible person is submitted to the Agency under the marketing authorisation ordinance and Articles 19-21. The MAH may apply for an additional local responsible person, besides one already approved, only for a new PV system.

f.title: Optionally appoint a qualified, Croatia-resident deputy and obtain Agency approval
f.statement: The MAH may appoint a deputy local responsible person who takes over contact with the Agency in the responsible person's absence. The deputy must be suitably qualified (medical doctor, dentist, pharmacist, medical biochemist or veterinarian, or documented training per Art. 21(1)), perform PV work for the MAH and reside in Croatia. The MAH must report the deputy's appointment, contacts and changes and obtain Agency approval.
f.exceptions: Appointment of a deputy is optional (para 1: "može imenovati").

For the deputy: appointment statement, diploma or training proof, contact details, proof of employment and any contract.

f.title: Parallel import holder is responsible for PV when the MAH has no approved local responsible person
f.statement: The holder of a parallel import authorisation is responsible for pharmacovigilance activities where the MAH has no approved local responsible person in Croatia, or where parallel import authorisation was granted under the Act.

f.title: Report all suspected ADRs and process ICSRs per GVP Module VI; do not report unrelated events
f.statement: The MAH must report all suspected ADRs to marketed products under Art. 151 of the Act and carry out collection, assessment and reporting of serious and non-serious ADRs to medicines and vaccines and ICSR preparation in line with GVP Module VI. Events assessed as not related are kept as adverse events and not reported to the Agency.
f.legal_basis: Zakon o lijekovima čl. 151; GVP Module VI

f.title: Perform signal detection per GVP Module IX
f.statement: The MAH must carry out activities to identify new or changed risks (signal detection) in accordance with GVP Module IX.

rows.quote: Nositelj odobrenja obvezan je aktivnosti u vezi s utvrđivanjem novih rizika ili promjenom poznatih rizika lijekova (detekcija signala) provoditi u skladu sa Smjernicom o dobroj farmakovigilancijskoj praksi (GVP) Modul IX

rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder is obliged to carry out activities relating to identification of new risks or changes in known risks of medicinal products (signal detection) in accordance with the Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practice (GVP) Module IX

f.title: Inform the Agency of events affecting the benefit-risk balance that are not ICSRs
f.statement: MAHs, parallel import holders, importers and wholesalers must inform the Agency of events or observations that may affect the benefit-risk balance and/or public health but do not qualify as ICSRs, in accordance with GVP Module VI.

rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. f.title: Report ADRs and safety data in special situations (pregnancy, children, overdose, errors, lack of efficacy)
f.statement: Applicants, MAHs, parallel import holders, importers and wholesalers must report adverse reactions and other safety-relevant data per GVP VI, and also in cases of use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, in children or the elderly, overdose, abuse, off-label use, misuse, medication errors or occupational exposure, and lack of efficacy.

f.title: Prepare and maintain a PSMF per GVP Module II for all authorised products
f.statement: The MAH must prepare and maintain a PSMF for all authorised products in line with GVP Module II; the Agency may request and assess the full PSMF during and after the authorisation procedure.

f.statement: The MAH must prepare and maintain a risk management system in accordance with Articles 49 and 149 of the Act and GVP Module V.

f.title: Obtain Agency approval before distributing aRMM educational materials; follow GVP XVI
f.statement: Additional risk minimisation measures are approved by the Agency regardless of the authorisation procedure; the MAH must follow GVP Module XVI and must obtain Agency approval before distributing educational materials or carrying out other aRMM activities, agreeing the content, recipient list, modality, timing and distribution. The Agency may ask the MAH to evaluate aRMM effectiveness.

f.statement: The EU QPPV must be involved in preparing, reviewing and evaluating non-interventional PASS protocols (GVP VIII). f.title: Agree DHPC content, plan, recipients and schedule with the Agency; no advertising; follow GVP XV

f.title: Distribute the revised PIL within the Agency deadline or with the first new batch, at the latest 6 months

rows.quote_en: The sponsor of the clinical trial or the sponsor's representative is obliged to carry out expedited reporting of adverse reactions from clinical trials in accordance with Article 152 of the Act

f.title: Submit a six-monthly SUSAR line listing with a safety summary to the Agency and the Central Ethics Committee
f.statement: At least every six months the sponsor must submit to the Agency and the Central Ethics Committee a line listing of all SUSARs from all EU Member States (and third countries where applicable) for the period, with a report on the main safety issues; the listing is submitted electronically on CD with a cover letter naming the trial titles and protocol codes in Croatia.

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor or sponsor representative (Croatia)
rows.quote: (1) Naručitelj kliničkog ispitivanja ili predstavnik naručitelja kliničkog ispitivanja obvezan je najmanje jednom u šest mjeseci Agenciji i SEP-u dostaviti linearni popis svih SUSAR-a iz svih država članica Europske unije te ako je primjenjivo i iz trećih zemalja za promatrano razdoblje, uz popratno izvješće naručitelja kliničkog ispitivanja ili predstavnika naručitelja kliničkog ispitivanja o glavnim sigurnosnim pitanjima
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. rows.quote_en: (1) The sponsor of the clinical trial or the sponsor's representative is obliged, at least once every six months, to submit to the Agency and the Central Ethics Committee a line listing of all SUSARs from all EU Member States and, where applicable, from third countries for the period under review, with an accompanying report of the sponsor or sponsor's representative on the main safety issues

f.title: Handle unblinding per CT-3
f.statement: The sponsor must carry out procedures for breaking the treatment blind in accordance with CT-3.

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor or sponsor representative (Croatia)
rows.quote: Naručitelj kliničkog ispitivanja ili predstavnik naručitelja kliničkog ispitivanja obvezan je postupke u svezi otkrivanja slijepe šifre terapije,provesti sukladno Detaljnim smjernicama
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. rows.quote_en: The sponsor of the clinical trial or the sponsor's representative is obliged to carry out the procedures relating to breaking of the treatment blind code in accordance with the Detailed guidance

f.title: Prepare DSURs per ICH E2F and submit them electronically with a cover letter
f.statement: The sponsor must meet DSUR obligations per ICH E2F and submit DSURs electronically on CD with a cover letter naming the trial titles and protocol codes in Croatia, until an electronic reporting system is established.

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor or sponsor representative (Croatia)
rows.quote: (1) Naručitelj kliničkog ispitivanja ili predstavnik naručitelja kliničkog ispitivanja obveze u svezi Izvješća o neškodljivosti lijeka u razvoju (DSUR) obvezan je provesti sukladno Smjernici ICH E2F.

rows.quote_en: (1) The sponsor of the clinical trial or the sponsor's representative is obliged to fulfil the obligations relating to the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR) in accordance with the ICH E2F Guideline.

f.title: Inform all investigators regularly of SUSARs and other safety data
f.statement: The sponsor must regularly inform all investigators of SUSARs recorded in the trial in Croatia, the EU and third countries, and of other safety data that could affect subject safety, per CT-3.

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor or sponsor representative (Croatia)
rows.quote: Naručitelj kliničkog ispitivanja ili predstavnik naručitelja kliničkog ispitivanja obvezan je sve ispitivače u kliničkom ispitivanju redovito izvješćivati o ozbiljnim neočekivanim nuspojavama zabilježenim u predmetnom kliničkom ispitivanju u Republici Hrvatskoj, Europskoj uniji i trećim zemljama, kao i drugim sigurnosnim podacima koji bi mogli imati utjecaj na sigurnost ispitanika u kliničkom ispitivanju
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. rows.quote_en: The sponsor of the clinical trial or the sponsor's representative is obliged to regularly inform all investigators in the clinical trial of serious unexpected adverse reactions recorded in the clinical trial concerned in the Republic of Croatia, the European Union and third countries, as well as of other safety data that could affect the safety of subjects in the clinical trial

f.title: Audit the pharmacovigilance system per GVP Module IV
f.statement: The Agency and the MAH must carry out internal audits of the pharmacovigilance system in accordance with GVP Module IV.

rows.quote: Agencija i nositelj odobrenja obvezni su provoditi unutarnji nadzor farmakovigilancijskog sustava u skladu sa Smjernicom o dobroj farmakovigilancijskoj praksi (GVP) Modul IV
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: The Agency and the marketing authorisation holder are obliged to carry out internal audit of the pharmacovigilance system in accordance with the Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practice (GVP) Module IV

f.title: For marketed CAPs, confirm an approved local responsible person within 30 days of entry into force
f.statement: For all centrally authorised products on the Croatian market, the MAH had to submit within 30 days of the Ordinance's entry into force an original written statement confirming it has an Agency-approved local person responsible for pharmacovigilance, with a copy of the approval; MAHs without one had to apply for approval.
f.applicability: Centrally authorised products marketed in Croatia

rows.deadline: Within 30 days of entry into force (by 2013-08-01)
rows.quote: (1) Za sve lijekove odobrene centraliziranim postupkom koji su na tržištu u Republici Hrvatskoj, nositelj odobrenja obvezan je u roku od 30 dana od dana stupanja na snagu ovoga Pravilnika Agenciji dostaviti pisanu izjavu, u izvorniku, kojom potvrđuje da raspolaže lokalnom osobom odgovornom za farmakovigilanciju koju je Agencija odobrila.
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; Croatian "obvezan je/mora/moraju" = shall/must (Mandatory), "treba/trebaju" = should (Recommended), "može" = may (Permitted). Review: historic transitional duty. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: (1) For all medicinal products authorised by the centralised procedure that are on the market in the Republic of Croatia, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged, within 30 days of the date of entry into force of this Ordinance, to submit to the Agency a written statement, in original, confirming that it has a local person responsible for pharmacovigilance approved by the Agency.

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana stupanja na snagu ovoga Pravilnika
deadline_rule.applies_to: statement confirming an approved local responsible person (CAPs)

f.title: Apply for local responsible person approval on change of MAH or local person for pre-July 2013 national products
f.statement: On change of MAH or of the local responsible person for products authorised nationally, by MRP or DCP before 1 July 2013 and valid on that date, the MAH must apply for approval of the local responsible person under Art. 19.

rows.quote: (4) U slučaju promjene nositelja odobrenja, odnosno lokalne odgovorne osobe nositelja odobrenja za lijekove odobrene nacionalnim postupkom, postupkom međusobnog priznavanja i decentraliziranim postupkom prije 1. srpnja 2013. godine čija su odobrenja za stavljanje u promet važeća na dan 1. srpnja 2013. godine nositelj odobrenja obvezan je Agenciji dostaviti zahtjev za odobrenjem lokalne odgovorne osobe u skladu s člankom 19. ovoga Pravilnika.
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. rows.quote_en: (4) In case of a change of the marketing authorisation holder, or of the local responsible person of the marketing authorisation holder, for medicinal products authorised by the national, mutual recognition or decentralised procedure before 1 July 2013 whose marketing authorisations are valid on 1 July 2013, the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to submit to the Agency an application for approval of the local responsible person in accordance with Article 19 of this Ordinance.

f.title: No PSUR obligation for certain old-law authorisations after 1 July 2013 unless Art. 169 applies
f.statement: For products with valid authorisations granted under Art. 15(a)-(b), 19 and 108 of the former Medicinal Products Act (NN 71/07, 45/09, 124/11), there is no PSUR obligation after 1 July 2013 except as provided in Art. 169 of the Act.
f.exceptions: Except cases under Art. 169 of the Act.

rows.quote: Za sve lijekove koji imaju važeće odobrenje za stavljanje u promet dana sukladno članku 15. točki a) i točki b), članku 19. i članku 108. Zakona o lijekovima (»Narodne novine«, br. 71/07, 45/09 i 124/11) nakon 1. srpnja 2013. godine ne postoji obveza podnošenja PSUR-eva, osim u slučajevima propisanim člankom 169. Zakona.
rows.review_note: National (Croatia) Ministry of Health Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 83/2013 (transposes Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU; adds national local-responsible-person, vaccine, PIL and clinical trial rules); marked national. rows.quote_en: For all medicinal products with a valid marketing authorisation granted in accordance with Article 15 point a) and point b), Article 19 and Article 108 of the Medicinal Products Act (Official Gazette Nos 71/07, 45/09 and 124/11), after 1 July 2013 there is no obligation to submit PSURs, except in cases prescribed by Article 169 of the Act.

dates.title: Croatian Ordinance on pharmacovigilance (NN 83/2013): enters into force
dates.scope: Applicants, MAHs, parallel import holders, importers, wholesalers, clinical trial sponsors, healthcare professionals and the Agency (HALMED)
dates.quote: Ovaj Pravilnik objavljuje se u »Narodnim novinama«, a stupa na snagu dana 2. srpnja 2013. godine.
dates.quote_en: This Ordinance shall be published in the Official Gazette and shall enter into force on 2 July 2013.
dates.timing_note: Replaces the Ordinance on pharmacovigilance NN 125/09 (Art. 57).
